## Finding

**Verdict:** likely_vacant (0.90 confidence).

Oakland parcel GIS reports the exact parcel as use code 4000, with no buildings, no building area, and $0 improvement value. Alameda County defines 4000 as vacant industrial land. The FY 2019-20 Oakland assessment roll also lists the parcel with code 400. Together these support a vacant-land classification.

**Vacancy start and duration:** unknown. The parcel was classified as vacant industrial land by February 2019 (about 7 years 8 months before October 2026), and current GIS still reports no buildings. Neither source proves the parcel was continuously vacant or dates the start of any vacancy. The 2000-10-27 last-document date in GIS is not a vacancy date.

Sources: [Oakland parcel GIS](https://gismaps.oaklandca.gov/server/rest/services/Oakland_Parcels/MapServer/0/query?where=FULL_SITUSADDRESS%3D%27271%205TH%20ST%20OAKLAND%2094607%27&outFields=PRINTPARCEL%2CFULL_SITUSADDRESS%2CSHP_USECODE%2CSHP_IMPRVMTS_VALUE%2CPC_NO_BUILDINGS%2CPC_BLDG_AREA%2CPC_BLDG_YEAR%2CLAST_DOCUMENT_DATE%2CPC_LOT_SIZE&returnGeometry=false&f=json); [Alameda County use codes](https://propinfo.acgov.org/UseCodeList/); [Oakland FY 2019-20 assessment roll](https://oakland.legistar.com/View.ashx?GUID=FD559A38-265D-4724-80F7-A5F39270C71F&ID=7129314&M=F).
